Hi, I'm Jose, Professor of Quantitative Criminology at the [University of Leeds](https://essl.leeds.ac.uk/law/staff/222/professor-jose-pina-sanchez), where I teach Criminology, Sociology, and Social Policy students about crime data and statistical modelling.

Here, you’ll find my latest papers, talks, and teaching materials, along with discussions of my work in progress and the occasional rant. Most of my research focuses on questions of [measurement](https://jmpinasanchez.github.io/measurement.html), [sentencing](https://jmpinasanchez.github.io/sentencing.html), [disparities](https://jmpinasanchez.github.io/disparities.html) and [road violence](https://jmpinasanchez.github.io/cars.html). If you're interested in any of these topics, feel free to reach out!
